summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting ongoing open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares on Euronext Milan from October 5 to 9, 2026, under the second tranche of a buyback program approved by the shareholders' meeting on May 6, 2026. The company acquired 4,079,351 shares (0.13% of share capital) at a weighted-average price of €24.5137 per share, for a total consideration of €99,999,853.56. Since the program start on May 8, 2026, Eni has repurchased 81,356,572 shares (2.69%) for €1,854,915,476.28, and now holds 168,184,679 treasury shares, equal to 5.55% of share capital. The purchases serve to provide shareholders an additional remuneration beyond dividends; no advisor or board recommendation is cited. Watch for execution pace and potential market impact as Eni continues daily buybacks, with treasury ownership already substantial.
